quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #11
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: A train has passed at a railroad crossing. What should you do?

options.text: Wait until the signal lights stop flashing.
Check for a second train.
Both of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both of the above.
questions.explanation: After a train passes, watch for a second train on any track. Do not proceed until all gates are raised and all warning signals have stopped flashing.

questions.question: When should you not use your horn?

options.text: When visibility ahead is limited.
If you might hit another vehicle.
Near blind pedestrians.

questions.correctAnswerText: Near blind pedestrians.
questions.explanation: Do not use your horn near a blind pedestrian. It may startle them. Yield to the pedestrian and go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line mean?

options.text: You can pass from the lane next to the solid yellow line.
You cannot pass from either direction.
You can pass from the lane next to the broken yellow line.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass from the lane next to the broken yellow line.
questions.explanation: When a broken yellow line is next to a solid yellow line, you can pass only from the lane next to the broken line. The lane next to the solid line cannot pass.

questions.question: Which statement about braking is correct?

options.text: Use your left foot to brake.
Use your right foot for both braking and accelerating.
Always brake hard to ensure stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your right foot for both braking and accelerating.
questions.explanation: Use your right foot for both braking and accelerating. Apply the brakes gently with steady pressure so your vehicle stops smoothly.

questions.question: When should you use turn signals when parking next to a curb?

options.text: Only when leaving the curb.
Only when pulling next to the curb.
When pulling next to the curb or when leaving the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pulling next to the curb or when leaving the curb.
questions.explanation: Always signal when pulling next to a curb and when leaving a curb.

questions.question: What should you do when changing lanes?

options.text: Use only the rearview mirror.
Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move.
Use only the left side mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move.
questions.explanation: Look over your shoulder to check for traffic in your blind spot before changing lanes. Check several times and watch the traffic in front of you and next to you.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line between two lanes mean?

options.text: Both lanes go in the same direction.
You can pass when it is safe.
You cannot pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line separates traffic moving in opposite directions. You can pass when there is no oncoming traffic in the passing lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks entering.
Truck exit only.
Steep downgrade ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steep downgrade ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downgrade is ahead. Check your brakes before going downhill.

questions.question: When is it safe to return to your lane after passing?

options.text: When you cannot see the vehicle directly to your right.
When you see the vehicle's headlights in your rearview mirror.
When you have passed the other vehicle's front bumper.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you see the vehicle's headlights in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Before returning to your lane, make sure you are far enough from the vehicle you passed. When you see both headlights in your rearview mirror, you have enough space to return safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Reduce your speed when the road is wet.
The road ahead has sharp turns or curves.
Traffic increases ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down when you see it.

questions.question: What color and shape are construction zone signs?

options.text: Square or rectangular with white and red.
Round or octagonal with black and yellow.
Diamond-shaped or rectangular with orange and black.

questions.correctAnswerText: Diamond-shaped or rectangular with orange and black.
questions.explanation: Work zone signs have an orange background with black letters or symbols. You will see them on the right side of the road, or on both sides if the road is divided.

questions.question: Before stopping at a traffic signal or sign, what should you do?

options.text: Press down hard on the accelerator.
Check your mirrors for traffic around you.
Set the parking brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors for traffic around you.
questions.explanation: When stopping, check your mirrors first for traffic. Watch other drivers as you slow down. Then move your foot to the brake and press smoothly to stop.

questions.question: What should you do at a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: At a flashing yellow light, slow down and continue carefully. You do not need to stop completely.

questions.question: Which statement about blind spots is correct?

options.text: One outside mirror eliminates all blind spots.
Large trucks have bigger blind spots than most cars.
You can see all blind spots in your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: Large trucks have bigger blind spots than most cars.
questions.explanation: Even with mirrors, all vehicles have blind spots you cannot see. Large trucks have much larger blind spots than most cars.

questions.question: When does your license expire?

options.text: On your birthday.
Never.
It renews automatically.

questions.correctAnswerText: On your birthday.
questions.explanation: Your license expires on your birthday. The Division of Vehicles will mail you a renewal notice or application at least 30 days before expiration.

questions.question: Why is night driving more dangerous than day driving?

options.text: You cannot see as far ahead.
The road is always more slippery.
Your reaction time is always slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot see as far ahead.
questions.explanation: At night, visibility is poor and headlight glare makes it hard to see ahead. Always use headlights and drive carefully in the dark.

questions.question: What do double solid yellow lines in the center of the road mean?

options.text: Passing is allowed from both directions.
Passing is allowed only from your direction.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is not allowed from either direction.
questions.explanation: Double yellow lines mean traffic from either direction cannot cross to pass.

questions.question: Drivers must obey instructions from:

options.text: Security guards in parking lots.
Other drivers with broken-down vehicles on the road.
Flaggers at construction sites.

questions.correctAnswerText: Flaggers at construction sites.
questions.explanation: Drivers must follow the signs and instructions of flaggers at construction sites. They are there to keep drivers and workers safe.

questions.question: If you park in an unusual spot, what should you do?

options.text: Keep your reverse lights on.
Make sure drivers can see your vehicle from any direction.
Park five feet from the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure drivers can see your vehicle from any direction.
questions.explanation: You are responsible for making sure your parked car is not a hazard. Park where drivers approaching from any direction can see it.

questions.question: Why do large trucks need extra space in front?

options.text: So other drivers can merge onto the freeway.
So the truck can stop.
So other drivers can slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: So the truck can stop.
questions.explanation: Trucks take longer to stop than cars at the same speed because they are larger. Do not pull in front of a truck and then slow down or stop.

questions.question: Before you start the engine, you should:

options.text: Put on your safety belt.
Make sure all passengers have put on their safety belts.
Both of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both of the above.
questions.explanation: Create a habit when getting in and out of your car. Before you start the engine, put on your safety belt and make sure all passengers do the same.

questions.question: When turning left, a driver must yield to:

options.text: Oncoming vehicles that are going straight or turning right.
Cars that are passing.
No one.

questions.correctAnswerText: Oncoming vehicles that are going straight or turning right.
questions.explanation: A driver making a left turn must yield to all vehicles coming from the opposite direction. This includes bicycles and motorcycles.

questions.question: You can drive off the road to pass another vehicle:

options.text: If the vehicle ahead is turning left.
If there are two or more lanes going in your direction.
Never.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never.
questions.explanation: You can never drive off the road or onto the shoulder to pass another vehicle.

questions.question: What should you do when you reach a broken traffic light?

options.text: Stop completely and yield before entering the intersection.
You can go if the intersection looks clear.
Drive fast through to get out of the way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and yield before entering the intersection.
questions.explanation: When a traffic light is not working, treat it as a four-way stop. Come to a complete stop, look both ways, and yield the right-of-way before entering the intersection.

questions.question: When driving in fog, you should:

options.text: Slow down and use your low beam headlights.
Slow down and use your high beam headlights.
Turn your lights on and off to warn other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and use your low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: When driving in fog, slow down and use your low beam headlights. If you cannot see, pull off the road and wait for the fog to clear.
